digest.component_or_area: test harness - nested pytest subprocess isolation
propositions: Nested pytest child process hangs after reporting 100% because pytest session shutdown synchronously scans and deletes stale entries in the shared user-global numbered temp root, consuming the entire 90-second timeout even though the selected test succeeded.
tests/_store_isolation.py omits the --basetemp argument when launching the nested pytest child, causing it to join the user-global numbered temp root instead of a caller-owned private temp directory.

Controlled A/B testing with 400,000 stale temp entries demonstrated that shared-root cleanup took 10.8s while private-basetemp cleanup took 0.882s, proving cleanup cost scales with retained unrelated entries.

The repair passes a caller-owned tmp_path/nested-pytest as --basetemp to the nested child, isolating pytest session-finish cleanup without changing test selection, environment, timeout, capture, or ambient-store assertions.
